blocks.text: Zscaler ITDR supports integration with third-party IT Service Management (ITSM) tools, such as ServiceNow, to track and assess issues across the Zscaler ITDR Admin Portal (AD domain, Entra ID, credential issues) and bad changes detected in the AD domain and Entra ID. You can configure ITDR with ServiceNow to:

blocks.item: Create ServiceNow tickets and assign the ticket to the appropriate user.
Track and assess the issues in both ServiceNow and the ITDR Admin Portal.

blocks.text: You can create only one ticket for an issue.

blocks.item: Locate ServiceNow and click the Edit icon under the Actions column.
Base URL: Enter the base URL of the ServiceNow instance.
Username: Enter the username for ServiceNow.
Password: Enter the password for ServiceNow.
(Optional) Click Test to validate the ServiceNow connection.

If the credentials are valid and ServiceNow can communicate with ITDR, a confirmation message appears indicating that the test is successful. If not, check the previous steps and try again. To learn more, refer to the ServiceNow documentation.

blocks.text: After configuring ITDR with ServiceNow, you must configure a ServiceNow webhook. To learn more, see Configuring a ServiceNow Webhook.
